prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Quick Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn how to interact, hide, or trigger pet behavior right from your desktop status bar.", "Right-click pet icon to access tray actions", "Use double-click to summon or chat with your pet"]
1: ["Select Your Pet Experience", "Choose between adopting a preset companion personality or crafting a custom companion.", "Choose Preset or Custom Path"]
2: ["Custom Pet Photo Inspector", "Upload clear, well-lit photos of your pet from front and side angles to guarantee optimal 3D desktop rendering.", "Front View Photo", "Side View Photo"]
3: ["Assembling Desktop Companion", "Your pet's 3D desktop assets and animations are currently being built and verified.", "Rendering 3D Assets..."]
4: ["Sign In to Protect Your Pets", "Your existing pet profiles and desktop settings will automatically restore upon sign-in."]
5: ["Checking graphics drivers, initializing desktop tray, and downloading pet sprites."]
6: ["Pick Your Companion (Takes 2 Mins)", "Select a ready-to-go starter pet or upload photos to create a custom companion for your desktop."]
7: ["You can minimize this window. We'll ping you as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop!"]
8: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Name your companion now to unlock an exclusive starter desktop collar accessory!", "Unlocked: Founder Collar"]
9: ["Your Pet Is Now Live on Your Desktop!", "Look for your pet active on screen or in your desktop system tray icon bar near the clock.", "If your pet hides, double-click the tray icon to bring them back to front."]

verdicts.problem: Promises a free extra item (exclusive accessory) to incentivize immediate action.
